concept: CloudHSM: customer-controlled single-tenant FIPS 140-2 Level 3 HSM
tests: Choosing between KMS and CloudHSM when keys must stay in a dedicated HSM fully controlled by the customer.
expected: AWS CloudHSM — single-tenant HSM, FIPS 140-2 Level 3, customer fully manages the keys. Triggers: "FIPS 140-2 Level 3", "hardware boundary that they fully control", "single-tenant".
why_not: KMS (AWS managed and customer managed keys) is multi-tenant, keys are managed by AWS infrastructure; ACM is for TLS certificates, not arbitrary encryption keys.
